about_lead: Blinca is a food delivery service for the Swedish market.
about_p1_body: We connect restaurants with people who would rather eat at home. The restaurant cooks the food; we handle the order and the delivery.
about_p2_body: The whole service is in Swedish, with English for those who prefer it. Prices are shown in kronor and include VAT.
about_p3_body: You only need one Blinca account. The same login works at every restaurant in the service.

seo_title_home: Blinca | Order food online and get it to your door
seo_desc_home: Order food from restaurants near you with Blinca. Pick a kitchen, place your order and follow the delivery all the way to your door.
seo_desc_how: How Blinca works: pick a kitchen, build your order, check out and follow the delivery. Food at your door, usually within 30–40 minutes.
seo_desc_about: About Blinca: a Swedish food delivery service that connects you with the best independent kitchens in your city, with low fees and weekly payouts.
seo_desc_contact: Contact Blinca with questions about an order, a partnership or anything else. Send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
seo_desc_login: Log in to your Blinca account to order food and follow your deliveries.
seo_desc_signup: Create a Blinca account to order food from restaurants and follow your delivery all the way home.
